jobs.title: VP, Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

As our VP of Strategic Partnerships, you will architect and lead the global partnership strategy that establishes Profound as the definitive platform for AI search optimization. You will define the vision, build the team, and personally drive the highest-leverage relationships across the AI ecosystem — from major agency networks and global systems integrators to hyperscale cloud marketplaces and enterprise B2B platforms.

This role operates at the executive level, sitting at the intersection of product strategy, revenue, and market positioning. You will own the full partnership lifecycle while leading cross-functional alignment to ensure deep integrations and joint go-to-market programs deliver transformational value for Profound and our partners.

What You'll Do

Define and execute Profound's global partnership strategy across product, channel, agency, and data partnerships — with direct accountability for partnership-sourced pipeline and revenue
Build and scale a Global Systems Integrator (GSI) program, establishing and deepening relationships with the likes of Accenture, Deloitte, Bain, Cap Gemini etc.
Own and grow Profound's presence within the Agency ecosystem — forging strategic alliances with holding companies and independent digital agencies who are shaping how brands approach AI search and discoverability
Develop and lead hyperscale go-to-market programs through cloud marketplaces including AWS Marketplace, Google Cloud Marketplace, and Azure — driving co-sell motions, committed spend agreements, and enterprise co-marketing investments
Structure and negotiate complex, executive-level partnership agreements balancing commercial terms, technical integration requirements, and long-term strategic value
Lead a cross-functional partnership function working closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, and Sales to take partnerships from concept through commercial launch
Serve as the executive point of contact for Profound's most strategic partners — leading QBRs, tracking performance, and proactively identifying expansion and upsell opportunities
Drive joint marketing initiatives, co-selling motions, and customer enablement programs alongside Marketing and Sales leadership
Represent Profound externally as a thought leader in the AI ecosystem — at industry events, in partner announcements, and through content and case studies
Maintain a living view of the AI ecosystem landscape and competitive dynamics, informing product and go-to-market strategy at the executive level

Who You Are

7+ years in strategic partnerships, business development, or alliances in high-growth technology or SaaS, with a demonstrated track record of building programs that drive significant revenue and product value
Deep experience running a GSI program
Proven experience navigating the Agency ecosystem — you understand how holding companies and independent agencies make technology decisions and how to position a platform as essential to their client work
Hands-on experience driving co-sell and marketplace programs through AWS, GCP, or Azure at scale, including marketplace listings, co-sell activation, and cloud-committed revenue motions
Deep fluency in the AI landscape — including LLM providers, AI platforms, search technologies, and the broader application layer — and a clear point of view on where it's heading
Executive-level communicator and relationship builder with a track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving commercial terms, data licensing, technical integrations, and joint go-to-market commitments
Existing C-suite and VP-level relationships across AI platform companies, agency networks, cloud providers, and enterprise SaaS
Experience leading and scaling partnerships teams in a high-growth startup environment
Background in analytics, marketing technology, SEO, or SaaS platforms serving enterprise customers is a strong plus

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager – Tech, Amazon Customer Service
jobs.description:
Description

Come build the future of Amazon Customer Service (CS) with us. Quality & Escalation’s vision is to deliver exceptional customer experiences that restore customer trust through continuous inspection, innovation, and improvement. Q&E exists to provides Tier 2 support to frontline teams when the ‘Andon cord’ is raised on customer experience issues. We resolve customer escalations across all sources while focusing on identifying and eliminating their root causes. We design and implement frameworks to measure service quality and lead technology and programmatic initiatives to continuously improve the quality of service across all CS interactions and touchpoints. Q&E is a large and impactful Operational, Program and Product teams across 6K Amazonians, spanning 30+ countries. (keep this in)

A key strategic priority for our organization is building the Customer Interception Model (CIM), Amazon CS's intelligent service recovery platform.

CIM transforms CS from reactive issue resolution to proactive customer recovery. By combining AI with customer, operational, and conversational signals, CIM detects service failures in real time, understands customer context, determines the appropriate recovery action, and orchestrates automated or human-assisted resolution. Through proactive recovery at scale, CIM enables Amazon to continuously earn and rebuild customer trust.

The Principal Product Manager – Tech, CIM owns the long-term product vision, strategy, and technical roadmap for one of Amazon CS's most strategic AI capabilities. This candidate will define how Amazon detects customer experience failures, reasons over customer and operational context, selects the optimal recovery strategy, and orchestrates automated and human-assisted resolutions across CS.

This role requires exceptional product judgment, deep technical fluency, and the ability to influence across Engineering, Applied Science, Data & Artificial Intelligence, Customer Experience, Operations, Finance, and other Partner teams. The successful candidate will translate complex business problems into scalable AI-powered products that improve customer trust and outcomes, reduce customer effort, lower our cost to serve, and redefine how Amazon delivers CS at global scale.

Key job responsibilities

Define, own, and drive the long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap for CIM, translating customer needs and business opportunities into scalable AI-powered product solutions.
Own product-level success metrics aligned to organizational goals, including improving customer trust, reducing repeat contacts and customer effort, strengthening foundational AI capabilities, and lowering cost to serve.
Lead end-to-end product execution across highly matrixed organizations, partnering closely with Eng, AS, D&AI, Ops, CX, Q&E, and partner product teams to deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.
Synthesize complex business, operational, and technical requirements into clear product narratives (PRFAQs, BRDs), prioritization frameworks, and execution plans that align senior stakeholders and enable scalable delivery.
Establish mechanisms to intake, prioritize, track, and measure product commitments, leveraging analytics, experimentation, and data-driven decision making to continuously improve customer recovery outcomes.
Optimize and evaluate product performance across the customer recovery lifecycle, using customer insights, telemetry, and operational metrics to drive continuous improvement.
Demonstrate deep technical fluency across AI systems, platform integrations, distributed architectures, and product dependencies, enabling effective partnership with engineering teams and informed product trade-off decisions.
Operate autonomously with high judgment in ambiguous and rapidly evolving environments, driving clarity where none exists while balancing rapid delivery with long-term platform scalability.
Influence product strategy across multiple organizations, aligning senior leaders around a shared vision while driving execution through collaboration rather than authority.
Develop and mentor the Technical Product Management community across the organization, fostering capability growth, technical excellence, and leadership development.

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience technical product management

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Relay Trust
jobs.description:
Description

Have you ever thought about what it takes to detect and prevent fraudulent transactions so that hundreds of millions of Amazon packages are received on time by our customers? What kinds of products and systems would you build to maximize customer satisfaction? Amazon is seeking a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about protecting customers and can thrive as an individual contributor on a diverse, global team.

The Relay Trust organization in Transportation Technology and Services (TTS) constantly innovates new ways of building distributed systems running the latest in machine learning algorithms to deliver the next generation of fraud prevention solutions for our customers. We hold high standards for our solutions and the services we deliver: our systems are highly secure, highly reliable, highly available, all while functioning at massive scale and delivering industry-leading precision. Our employees are intelligent, passionate about protecting customers, and fun to work with.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own a defined product area within our fraud prevention portfolio. You will analyze and identify specific instances of risk, broader risk trends, and points of customer friction, then define and deliver scalable products and solutions for prevention. You will collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams worldwide and within TTS to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver against high organizational standards. You will apply a breadth of tools, data sources, and analytical techniques to answer a wide range of high-impact business questions, and you will proactively present new insights in a concise and effective manner. You will work directly with partners in engineering and machine learning to develop new tools and revise risk models. You will also build the operational and business metrics for your area and use those metrics to identify improvement opportunities.

This is an individual contributor role. You will own the roadmap for your product area end to end, from problem definition through launch, and you will drive results by partnering closely with engineering, science, and business stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product vision and roadmap for a defined risk detection and prevention area, aligning priorities with engineering, science, and business stakeholders against shared goals.
Lead well-scoped problems that carry significant ambiguity, breaking them down into clear requirements and a deliverable plan.
Define product requirements and success metrics for automation, machine learning, and tooling investments that improve fraud prevention accuracy and operational efficiency.
Drive data-informed product decisions by leveraging business analysis, risk trends, and customer friction insights to prioritize the highest-impact opportunities within your area.
Build scalable measurement frameworks and continuous monitoring products focused on carrier partner compliance and emerging risk areas.
Partner across engineering and science teams to translate new technologies (ML models, signals, identity verification) into shipped product capabilities.
Mentor junior product managers and business analysts, and contribute to the norms and standards of the product team.

About The Team

Relay Trust is the fraud prevention and risk management product team within Amazon's Transportation Technology and Services (TTS) organization. Our mission is to protect Amazon's middle-mile transportation network, our carrier partners, and ultimately our customers from fraud, misuse, and abuse at global scale. We build products powered by machine learning, real-time signals, and data-driven decision systems that detect and prevent risk across identity verification, cargo integrity, and carrier compliance.

TTS's vision is to reinvent how customers of all sizes move goods, powered by tech, driven by science, and guided by data. Within that mission, Relay Trust operates at the intersection of product innovation and operational protection. Our systems process thousands of decisions per second, integrate signals from GPS, cameras, and device telemetry, and directly influence billions of dollars in transportation

transactions annually.

We are a cross-functional team spanning product management, engineering, applied science, and risk operations across North America and Europe. We value bold invention over incremental improvements, move fast through simple solutions, and believe constraints fuel our best work. You will collaborate with senior leadership with high visibility, and partner across 10+ organizations to ship products that make logistics safer and more efficient at planetary scale.

5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with end to end product delivery
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience as a product manager or owner
Experience owning technology products

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Media Generation Experience
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Every new model capability Firefly ships should show up everywhere a creator might want it, immediately — without each surface rebuilding the same prompt-to-output experience from scratch. That's the platform this role gets to build: a single, reusable generation experience any Firefly surface can adopt, configure, and extend as new capabilities arrive.

This is as much a craft problem as a technical one. The experience has to feel simple and obvious, with real depth underneath for the surfaces that need it. We're looking for one of the strongest partners the design org has! This only works as a genuinely well-crafted shared experience teams want to adopt, not a spec handed down from engineering.

What you'll Do

Build The Generation Experience As a Platform

Own the requirements, architecture-level tradeoffs, and rollout plan for a shared prompting and generation experience that works across every Firefly surface.
Balance what's core and universal versus what's configurable per surface.
Partner deeply with engineering on the technical contract underneath: how it talks to Firefly's generation services, how new models become available without client-side rework, and how the whole thing stays fast and light wherever it's embedded.

Be an exceptional partner to design

Work hand-in-hand with the design team to shape what this experience actually looks and feels like, balancing a small, obvious set of controls for most people with real capability underneath for those who need more.
Own how it scales across a wide range of surfaces, model types, and workflows, and navigate what that means as the product becomes more agentic and editing and generation converge — without every variation feeling like its own product. How would you draw that line?

Own Activation: turning new capability into a shipped experience on day one

Watch new capabilities as they emerge, from research, competitors, and the model landscape broadly. Decide the right use case, surface, and experience before anyone starts building.
Shape and deliver the launch experience that puts new capability in front of creators immediately!
Take direct ownership of the new experiences that don't fit the existing pattern yet. This role defines the next interaction pattern, not just maintains the current one.

What you'll Need

Strong product management experience with a track record of shipping platform-level or shared-component experiences that multiple teams adopt.
Excellent design instincts and genuine fluency partnering with designers. This role co-leads experience decisions, not just gathers requirements.
Technical depth sufficient to engage credibly on architecture tradeoffs.
A strong point of view on a unified direction, and the patience to build real support across teams with their own preferences.
An eye for genuinely new interaction patterns as capabilities emerge, not just maintenance of what already exists.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Description

Ready to shape the trajectory of applied AI and build breakthrough solutions that redefine what's possible for customers?

We are seeking an experienced AI Principal Product Manager - Technical to own the end-to-end lifecycle of large-scale AI products that transform how millions of customers experience Amazon. This role combines deep technical acumen with business strategy to drive products that don't just meet requirements, they redefine what's possible in customer service and experience at global scale.

The Data Intelligence team is a new function within Amazon Customer Service. a global, cross-functional organization of applied scientists, data scientists, economists, software engineers, data engineers, and technical product managers dedicated to advancing AI capabilities. We build data solutions and contextual intelligence using Generative AI, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Ontology, Agentic AI, Multi-Agent Architectures, Reinforcement Learning, Knowledge Graphs, and Model Context Protocol. We move with urgency, build for the long term, and obsess over getting customer experience right, because our work succeeds only when it creates meaningful impact and improves outcomes for customers.

Key job responsibilities

Own the Complete Product Lifecycle: You will define and communicate strategic vision and long-term roadmaps, drive cross-functional teams toward successful execution, and maintain accountability for customer outcomes and product reliability.
Develop Product Strategy and Communications: You will craft clear, differentiated value propositions tailored for diverse audiences including leadership.
Navigate Ambiguity and Drive Invention: You will identify where invention is needed, take smart risks, distinguish between one-way and two-way doors, and ensure gaps and opportunities within or between regions, architectures, and business organizations are identified and addressed.
Build Consensus Across Functions: You will partner effectively with design, engineering, science, and other leaders to align roadmap priorities and influence cross-functional strategies.
Develop and Mentor Technical Product Leaders: You will actively contribute to talent acquisition, participate in hiring and interview processes, and play a role in the career development of other product managers.

A day in the life

A typical day as an AI Product Manager, Technical, in the Data Intelligence team involves combining strategic vision with hands-on problem-solving across machine learning, generative AI, natural language processing, agentic AI, multi-agentic AI architectures, and advanced data science. You will own complex product initiatives, ensure alignment with customer needs and business objectives, and translate customer and business requirements into practical AI-driven solutions.

Working collaboratively with cross-functional teams including applied scientists, data engineers, software engineers, and business leaders, you will define product direction, evaluate technical approaches, and focus on customer impact, efficiency, and scalability.

Daily activities include reviewing customer feedback and performance data, identifying product opportunities and risks, and operating like a startup leader.

About The Team

The Data Intelligence team is a new function within Amazon Customer Service, a global, cross-functional organization of applied scientists, data scientists, economists, software engineers, data engineers, and technical product managers dedicated to advancing AI capabilities and creating meaningful impact for customers.

We build data solutions and contextual intelligence using Generative AI, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Ontology, Agentic AI, Multi-Agentic AI Architectures, Reinforcement Learning, Knowledge Graphs, and Model Context Protocol. We move with urgency, build for the long term, and prioritize getting customer experience right, because our work is only successful when it meaningfully improves outcomes for customers.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
7+ years of end to end product delivery experience
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience as a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and effectively influence across cross-functional teams

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About The Role

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers
(Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists
(Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today.

The Builder Leadership Experience

Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale.
AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up.
Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.

What You'll Actually Be Building & Execution

Leadership & Team Excellence

Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm.
Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months.

Technical Strategy & Authority

Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration.
Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies.

Customer & Business Impact

Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.
Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.

You're Our Builder Lead If…

You Have Proven Leadership: 4+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent.
You Bring Advanced Technical Depth: Deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.
You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.
You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects.
You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it.

Nice-to-Haves

Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines.
Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Head of Facebook Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Facebook helps more than 3 billion people around the world connect, share, and build community. From reconnecting with old friends to discovering local groups, marketplaces, and creators, the Facebook app is where people come to find the people and things they care about. As one of the world's largest consumer products, Facebook is continuously reinventing itself, investing in video, AI-powered discovery, creators, groups, and marketplace experiences that keep the app vital for the next generation of users.We are looking for a seasoned, visionary product marketing leader to lead the transformation of Facebook's product marketing organization and the global team of product marketers behind it. This leader will set the vision and strategy for how Facebook grows relevance with the next generation and delivers more value to core users, influencing product strategies and roadmaps, and driving product launches and go-to-market in the US and key global markets. Success looks like moving Facebook from an app that's “around” to an app that's essential.The ideal candidate will be able to build and drive product strategy, with a deep understanding of the industry competitive landscape, trends, and business models. They will bring the operational rigor and organizational leadership to align a large, global team and its cross-functional partners behind a single, ambitious agenda.

Head of Facebook Product Marketing Responsibilities:

Build, lead, and develop a large, global team of product marketers driving strategic consumer initiatives across the Facebook app.
People management is a core responsibility of this role: hiring and organizational design, coaching and performance management, and career development across a large, multi-layered team.
Set the vision and strategy for how Facebook grows relevance with the next generation and delivers deeper value to core users, including the positioning frameworks that guide Facebook across existing and new markets and user segments.
Have a pulse on the consumer and on culture, and marry the two with business and product strategy to develop marketing that moves consumers at scale, influencing product strategy and roadmaps as the voice of the consumer.
Shape the Facebook narrative: partner with product to make it true, and partner with cross-functional teams to land it with consumers and in culture.
Lead analysis and diagnosis around key opportunity areas across markets, cohorts, and surfaces (Feed, Video, Groups, Marketplace, Dating, Messaging, AI experiences) to drive growth through the funnel.
Plan and lead successful product launches and go-to-market in the US and key global markets, educating people on new Facebook experiences and driving adoption, usage, and retention.
Lead and collaborate across cross-functional teams (product, engineering, data science, brand, PR, legal, policy) and the broader ecosystem — creators, communities, small businesses, policy makers, news media, and advocates — to create integrated marketing moments that are contextually relevant.

Minimum Qualifications:

15+ years of experience in product marketing, growth marketing, or related disciplines for internet and/or consumer technology, including leading product marketing teams
Track record of successfully building, mentoring, and leading a large and diverse global team
Experience partnering closely with product management and engineering to represent market requirements and shape roadmap, and with brand and growth marketing partners to bring products and campaigns to market
Ability to lead matrixed organizations and functions toward common goals with operational rigor and enthusiasm
Knowledge and understanding of a wide range of industry landscapes, including but not limited to social media, short-form and long-form video, creator economy, online marketplaces, privacy, and integrity
Proven experience leveraging data to solve complex problems and drive user acquisition and engagement strategies

Preferred Qualifications:

Product marketing experience spanning marketing communications and/or product management
Experience marketing products at significant scale (100M+ users) as well as launching new, early-stage products
Experience with end-to-end product lifecycle management
Experience repositioning or revitalizing a mature consumer product for new audiences
Global experience working across a number of markets, with knowledge of diverse cultural, social, and business landscapes
MBA degree
Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. jobs.description:

. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
11 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, or analytics in a technology company.
Experience working with and analyzing data, and managing multiple cross-functional programs or projects.
Experience leading teams on cross-company initiatives and aligning recommendations with executive leadership.

Preferred qualifications:

Advanced degree or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with R, SQL, spreadsheets, or similar analytics tools.
Experience working with product and engineering teams.
Excellent communication and presentation skills (written and verbal) and the ability to influence cross-functionally at various levels.

About The Job

Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.

The Business Operations and Strategy team at Google plays a critical role in defining and driving strategic, operational and organizational improvements across the company. The team, also known as "BizOps", operates like an internal consulting group working on a range of critical projects and issues.

Google's leadership team hand-picks business challenges, and members of Business Operations (BizOps) work in small teams to find solutions. These include defining and executing our strategy on company-wide priorities like transforming Google into the world’s first AI-native enterprise, shaping the development of AI technologies and products, and developing go-to-market or monetization strategies as Customer Zero of these products. BizOps is at the forefront of Google's fast-moving strategic priorities like AI Transformation, addressing operational challenges and enabling innovation.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Structure and execute operational and initiatives by developing work plans, gathering and synthesizing relevant data, leading analyses, and developing final recommendations.

Communicate findings to management and to the broader organization.

jobs.title: Head of Global Renewals
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Renewals Leader to build and scale the function that protects and grows Anthropic’s recurring and committed revenue. This role owns renewals strategy, execution, and forecasting — ensuring we deliver exceptional customer outcomes while sustaining durable, predictable revenue as our enterprise base scales.

Anthropic operates on a consumption-based model, which makes this fundamentally different from a traditional renewals role. Your team won’t simply be renewing contracts on a fixed cycle — they’ll be managing customer commitments in step with real usage, catching consumption risk early, and converting healthy adoption into expanded commitments. You’ll build the playbooks, the forecasting rigor, and the early-warning systems that make retention a strength rather than a scramble.

You’ll lead and develop a team of Renewals Managers, partner closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, and Customer Success, and serve as a trusted commercial voice in front of strategic customers. This is a builder’s role: you’ll be one of the first dedicated leaders for this function, so the processes, culture, and standards you set become the template.

What You'll Do

Build and lead the renewals team. Hire, develop, and retain a team of Renewals Managers. Define how the function covers the customer base, set the performance bar, and create a culture of accountability and customer-centricity.
Own the renewal number. Own renewal bookings, gross and net retention, on-time renewal metrics, forecast accuracy, and renewal pipeline health. Identify risk early and implement mitigation strategies to reduce churn and contraction.
Define the operating model. Establish scalable renewal playbooks, stage definitions, qualification criteria, and operational rigor — adapted for the realities of consumption-based revenue rather than fixed contract cycles.
Forecast with rigor. Drive accurate weekly and monthly renewal forecasting and reporting that leadership can plan against, grounded in usage data and customer health signals.
Drive expansion at renewal. Partner with Sales and Customer Success to convert adoption depth into expanded commitments, and lead executive-level renewal conversations for strategic accounts where required.
Collaborate across the GTM organization. Work with Sales on territory and account strategy, with Deal Desk and Finance on pricing, terms, and approvals, and with Strategy & Operations on forecasting and field alignment.
Lead with an AI-first mindset. Use data, automation, and tooling — including Claude — to optimize renewal processes, monitor KPIs, and continuously raise the bar on performance.

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

8–12+ years of experience in SaaS, PaaS, or consumption-led businesses, with significant exposure to renewals, retention, sales, or customer success
3–5+ years of people management experience leading renewals, retention, or commercial teams
A proven track record of owning and exceeding renewal and retention targets in complex, enterprise deal cycles
Excellent forecasting and pipeline management skills, with a reliable, evidence-based approach to calling the number
Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders — Sales, Finance, Deal Desk, and Customer Success — at all levels
A strong analytical mindset and comfort using data to drive decisions

Strong Candidates May Also Have

Direct experience with consumption-based or usage-based pricing models, and the unique retention dynamics they create
Background in data, AI, cloud, or developer-platform businesses
Experience building a renewals or retention function from the ground up, including playbooks, forecasting cadence, and team structure
Experience operating across multiple regions and markets
Passion for AI and alignment with Anthropic's mission of beneficial AI development

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$200,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Director, Integrated Strategy (B2B)
jobs.description:
YOUR MINDSET

You have developed fluency in disciplines most people keep separate. You don't see creative strategy, experience strategy and media strategy as different languages. You see them as different expressions of the same brilliant strategic thinking and that fluency informs everything you do.
You believe that the best creative ideas scale, that strategic coherence matters, and that you grow by collaborating with people who think differently than you. You contribute with conviction and follow-through. You help build a culture where people understand how their work fits into something bigger and you are here for more than your role. You understand that ideas and how they reach people are equally important—not one secondary to the other.

ROLE OVERVIEW

You will develop and execute a range of integrated strategy projects for one or two B2B brands. One of those brands is a multi-brand healthcare enterprise where you will translating strategic direction into inspirational insights and briefs that enable great creative, content and experience execution to come together.

This role demands fluency in two disciplines that most separate: Brand Strategy and Connections Strategy. You work from both perspectives simultaneously. You don't just translate between them,you hold them together with clear strategic thinking that helps them operate as one. You understand how strategy needs to live across earned, owned, and paid channels—including social and influencer partnerships and sales enablement.

You turn strategic direction into clear big ideas and briefs grounded in buying group insight and media possibility. You work with creative content, experience and media teams to help them understand how their work fits together into a coherent whole and inspire both to think bigger and think together. You are the bold strategic voice in the room who helps teams see how their work connects and why that connection matters.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Development — Ideas & Brief

Translate strategic direction into powerful Catalyzing Ideas and briefs grounded in creative insight and contextual possibility
Build the strategic rationale—not just what we're doing, but why it matters and how it moves the business
Develop brand worlds that breathe life into ideas—articulating character, conviction, and edges with specificity
Help creative teams uncover the strategic insight that should drive their work. Identify how ideas work across the full B2B lifecycle. Help media teams see how that idea scales. Understand how ideas need to live in social and influencer contexts
Develop content and sales enablement strategies that support the buying experience – going beyond the expected to elevate the brand a thought leader in the category while optimizing for LLMs

Strategic System Operationalization

Identify WHERE ideas reach the right buying groups and HOW they show up in context—across paid media, owned channels, social platforms, and influencer partnerships
Research and surface buyer signals that inform where and when strategy becomes relevant and urgent
Understand signal stacking—how multiple signals cluster to create moments of greatest impact
Help teams understand how their work feeds the whole and why that connection matters

Cross-Disciplinary Alignment & Leadership

Work with creative, content, media, social, and influencer partners to ensure strategy translates consistently across all touchpoints
Help creative teams understand the experience strategy and what's possible. Help media teams understand creative strategy and what ideas demand. Bridge social and influencer thinking into the broader strategic conversation.
Bridge creative and media conversations so both disciplines understand they're working from the same foundation
Think all languages simultaneously—you are fluent in creative strategy, experience strategy, content strategy AND media strategy, weaving them together

Stakeholder Communication & Relationship Building

Brief brand partners and internal stakeholders on strategy with clarity and confidence
Be a reliable strategic voice partners turn to when asking "how should this idea work?" or "how does this fit what we're doing?"
Engage with senior team to gather input and ensure alignment with enterprise priorities

Team Contribution & Development

Support team leadership by modeling integrated thinking
Mentor junior strategists, helping them understand systems thinking, not just tactical execution
Ask good questions that help teams think beyond their discipline
Contribute to creating psychological safety where people challenge siloed thinking

Measurement & Learning

Help monitor how strategy translates in market and gather feedback for refinement
Support measurement that tracks whether the system is working, using data as feedback not just reporting
Contribute insights on how ideas are propagating and whether signals are clustering as predicted

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Your strategic briefs are clear, actionable, and inspiring. You are a student of great work and hungry to do your best work
Creative, content and media partners use your strategy as a real tool, not just a document. They understand how the two disciplines work together
Teams understand the coherence in what they're building—how each piece connects to the whole. They think in systems, not just tactics
You've demonstrated you can develop strategy and help bring it to life in integrated ways
Junior strategists learn systems thinking by working with you. You are an inspiring mentor to junior talent
Measurement shows ideas propagating and signals clustering as predicted
Relationships deepen because you bring perspective that helps partners operate more strategically

KEY QUALIFICATIONS

Experience:

6-10 years strategy experience with demonstrated fluency in creative strategy, content strategy, experience strategy AND media strategy
Proven ability to develop and communicate breakthrough strategic thinking, not just execute briefs
Track record working on B2B brands in complex strategic environments
Experience working across creative, content, experience and media functions
Comfort engaging with senior stakeholders in strategic conversations
Experience with social media platforms and/or influencer partnerships a plus

Intellectual Foundation:

Understanding of how ideas propagate and land in culture—not just single-moment performance
Ability to hold multiple perspectives, audiences, and signals in mind simultaneously
Comfort moving between strategic thinking and tactical execution, between 30,000 feet and the work itself
Understanding of signal stacking—how audience signals cluster to create moments of greatest impact
Genuine curiosity about how creative and experience thinking complement and inform each other
Evidence that you think about systems, not just campaigns
Evidence that you learn from people and disciplines different from your own

Communication & Collaboration:

Strong communicator who can brief stakeholders with clarity
Ability to contribute ideas within a broader strategic framework
Genuine interest in how creative and experience thinking complement each other
Collaborative spirit; you get smarter working with others
Ability to mentor and develop other strategists

Additional Information

In delivery, you're the Directly Responsible Individual on engagements — owning the client relationship, running the discovery and scoping work, and accountable for the outcome. Underpinning both, you build out the vertical point of view — the industry and AI expertise that makes Advisory credible — and, as one of the function's first hires, help build the Advisory motion itself. Build the vertical point of view. You develop your vertical's point of view — the AI-shaped problems, best practices, technology and learnings, and buyer-peer and competitor intelligence that make Advisory credible in the field.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Partner Search
jobs.description:
Yahoo serves as a trusted guide for hundreds of millions of people globally, helping them achieve their goals online through our portfolio of iconic products. For advertisers, Yahoo Advertising offers omnichannel solutions and powerful data to engage with our brands and deliver results.

Director, Product Management, Partner Search

A Little About Us

Yahoo Search helps millions of people find information, answers, products, services, and inspiration across the web. In addition to our owned and operated Search experiences, Yahoo powers Search for a broad ecosystem of third-party distribution partners across browsers, software, APIs, and other consumer and B2B experiences.

The Partner Search team is responsible for growing and evolving that ecosystem. We build products and platform capabilities that help partners deliver high-quality Search experiences, grow user engagement and lifetime value, improve monetization, and scale their businesses with Yahoo. The team works at the intersection of consumer Search, partner platforms, APIs, monetization, traffic quality, data, and business development.

About The Role

We are seeking a Director of Product Management, Partner Search
to lead product strategy and execution for Yahoo’s third-party Search business.

This is a hands-on product leadership role that combines individual product ownership with people management. You will manage a small team of Product Managers while also directly owning a meaningful product area. Together, the team will be responsible for growing partner traffic and revenue, improving retention and lifetime value, increasing monetization, and making Yahoo’s partner Search platform more scalable and differentiated.

You will define product strategy across partner experiences, Search distribution, APIs, data and reporting, monetization, and platform capabilities. You will also identify and develop new B2B products and distribution opportunities that expand how partners can work with Yahoo.

The role requires strong commercial judgment, technical fluency, and comfort working directly with external partners. You will partner closely with Business Development and Partner Management, while serving as the senior Product counterpart in partner discussions, shaping joint product opportunities, diagnosing performance issues, and translating partner needs into scalable Yahoo products.

We are looking for someone who can operate like a product GM for the partner Search portfolio: setting direction, developing new ideas, driving measurable growth, coaching PMs, and personally getting into the details of product, data, APIs, traffic quality, monetization, and partner performance.

Responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and performance of Yahoo’s Partner Search portfolio, with accountability for partner traffic, revenue, retention, lifetime value, monetization, and platform scalability.
Lead and develop a small team of Product Managers while personally owning a meaningful product area and remaining deeply engaged in product discovery, prioritization, execution, and performance.
Develop a deep understanding of distribution partners, their users, business models, traffic sources, and economics, using partner feedback, product data, market context, and performance trends to identify the highest-value opportunities.
Define product strategy for third-party Search experiences, balancing partner needs, end-user value, platform scalability, traffic quality, and Yahoo business objectives.
Improve partner configurability and flexibility across Search experiences, features, branding, data, APIs, and integrations, while avoiding excessive operational or technical complexity.
Drive initiatives that improve user retention, engagement, search volume, and lifetime value across distributed traffic, identifying and testing the product levers that strengthen repeat usage and partner economics.
Optimize monetization across partner experiences through new features, Search experience improvements, traffic and query optimization, and other product levers that improve revenue while maintaining partner and user value.
Identify, prototype, and launch new B2B Search products and distribution opportunities, including new partner capabilities, commercial experiences, APIs, and product models that expand Yahoo’s addressable market.
Build scalable platform capabilities rather than one-off partner solutions, including partner data and reporting, Search and XML APIs, syndication capabilities, configuration frameworks, and reusable platform services.
Own and improve critical partner ecosystem capabilities related to traffic quality, integrity, and compliance, including areas such as chain of custody, invalid traffic, domain matching, parked domain traffic, and partner traffic governance.
Use experimentation and performance measurement to guide decisions, define success metrics, evaluate tradeoffs, and continuously identify new monetization and growth “jolts” across the partner portfolio.
Partner closely with Business Development, Partner Management, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Data Science, Monetization, Legal, Privacy, and other teams to launch new capabilities and improve existing partner integrations.
Serve as a senior Product counterpart to strategic partners, helping shape joint product roadmaps, identify new opportunities, diagnose issues, and translate partner-specific needs into scalable product investments.
Monitor the health and evolution of the partner portfolio across adoption, traffic quality, retention, monetization, partner satisfaction, competitive dynamics, and platform cost to determine where to invest, simplify, or change direction.

Minimum Qualifications

9+ years of Product Management or equivalent experience, including significant experience building and scaling consumer, platform, partner, distribution, or monetization products, with proven experience managing PMs and driving large-scale platform or distribution portfolios.
Experience leading Product Managers while continuing to operate as a hands-on product leader with direct ownership of meaningful product scope.
Demonstrated success growing a product or business through improvements in traffic, engagement, retention, lifetime value, revenue, monetization, or distribution.
Experience working with external partners in a B2B2C, platform, syndication, distribution, OEM, browser, marketplace, or similar ecosystem.
Strong product and commercial judgment, with the ability to understand partner economics, identify new growth opportunities, and balance partner needs with end-user and business outcomes.
Technical fluency sufficient to work deeply with engineers on APIs, partner integrations, data flows, platform architecture, experimentation systems, traffic quality, and scalable configuration capabilities.
Strong analytical skills and experience using product data, experimentation, cohort analysis, retention, LTV, traffic quality, and monetization metrics to guide product decisions.
Demonstrated ability to translate individual partner needs into scalable platform products rather than relying on one-off custom solutions.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to work directly with senior external partners and communicate product strategy, performance, tradeoffs, and recommendations to executives.
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments, identify new product opportunities, and move fluidly between long-term strategy and detailed product execution.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
Description

The primary responsibilities of the Search Marketing organization are to drive web site traffic, maximize channel revenue and improve the end customer experience wherever they are in their shopping journey across the web. We manage Earned (SEO) and Paid Search marketing channels on external search engines and emerging partners including AI driven experiences and run experiments with a view to programmatically improve our ROI and find levers to grow the Amazon stores business. Our channel is one of the largest levers for Amazon business and new customer acquisition. We work with internal customers across all levels of the organization worldwide and enjoy the challenges and rewards of working in a fast-growing organization.

We are seeking a seasoned Product Manager to lead Paid Search channel marketing for one of Amazon's largest managed traffic driving channels. In this role, you will lead the development and execution of the paid and organic digital marketing strategy. This is a high-visibility position with scope for creativity and self-development. You will develop a detailed understanding of digital marketing (SEO/SEM in particular) and understand the long-term financial impact of customer behavior trends. The role requires a highly analytical mindset as well as a curiosity to seek out new possibilities. You should be strong at and attracted to the analytical and technical side of digital marketing as well as to the creative and experimental side, consistently using one to inform the other. You will be comfortable thinking big and diving deep. You will be the single point of contact and a dedicated owner for specific areas of the business and will be the search team's expert for that product line, gathering insights and applying learnings to additional lines of business / countries.

The successful candidate will think strategically and execute rigorously. You must be able to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. You will anticipate and remove bottlenecks, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus constraints. You will be at the center of the customer experience and need to dive into the customers’ responses, incremental business impact, and budget justification on your program, which requires strong analytical skills. You Earn the Trust of your stakeholders and influence them. You look around corners for potential opportunities or challenges and proactively put in place plans to address them.

Key job responsibilities

Develop deep search channel insights and understanding in partnership with retail teams, other marketing channel teams, and international stakeholders
Translate channel insights into test plans, product/feature proposals, and opportunities for optimization
Define and run tests, including A/B experiments to test new vendor features and/or inform new product development using your judgement across relative priorities
Conduct in-depth analyses to refine our understanding of the search space and uncover additional optimization opportunities
Translate analytical findings into actionable insights and concise business actions and recommendations

A day in the life

Your morning starts with a partner sync shaping how AI-powered Ad formats replace traditional search targeting approaches for optimization. Before your coffee gets cold, you're reviewing an ML model classifying millions of queries into intent channels with scientists. After lunch, you're sizing a campaign across WW marketplaces, then pivoting to a social commerce API integration review. You'll juggle external partners, science teams, marketing managers across countries, and engineering sprints — often in the same hour. If you thrive in organized chaos and get energy from connecting generative AI, programmatic advertising, and real-time bidding — this role is for you.

About The Team

Search Marketing drives how Amazon acquires customers through search-based experiences worldwide. We operate billions of ad interactions daily across major search platforms, optimizing in real-time to bring the right customers to Amazon. Our mission: maximize customer acquisition efficiency through automation, science, and strategic partner relationships. The team blends product management, applied science, engineering, and marketing, building AI-powered systems that replace manual processes at global scale. We're a small, high-autonomy group where individuals own entire product areas end-to-end, ship fast, and influence billions in revenue. Culture is data driven, experiment-heavy, and biased toward action.

10+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements

jobs.description:
Description

The FBA Inventory team is responsible for one of the most strategically critical and technically complex challenges in Amazon's supply chain: managing the inventory volume sent to and stored in the Amazon Fulfillment Network (AFN) across 1MM+ sellers worldwide, while enabling sellers to grow at the pace they desire. Our team sits at the intersection of seller economics, network operations, and latest science thinking — uniquely positioned to align incentives between Amazon and sellers to maximize GMS, optimize network health, and deliver a best-in-class seller experience.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, results-oriented Principal Product Manager – Technical to lead Project Atlas — Amazon's durable target-state architecture for policy-owned inventory enforcement orchestration running inventory removal driven defects down to zero. This is a rare opportunity to own a platform that directly influences seller trust at scale, the integrity of Amazon's compliance posture across every marketplace, and the efficiency of the global fulfillment network. You will drive the strategy and roadmap spanning policy-authoring systems, action APIs, appeal-aware control logic, and the lifecycle-of-record systems that power them — building products that resolve policy intent, seller remediation, appeal state, and removal eligibility upstream, so downstream inventory and removal systems can correctly take execution actions.

Key job responsibilities

Own the FBA platform roadmap for Project Atlas — Amazon's durable target-state architecture for policy-owned enforcement orchestration — and the next-generation enforcement experience that turns downstream systems into stateless executors of upstream policy decisions.
Drive the shift to policy-owned enforcement, replacing bundled downstream workflows with discrete, policy-issued action primitives each with its own timing, owner, and result.
Build seller-protecting controls that make enforcement deterministic, transparent, and appeal-aware — including irreversible-action gates checked against active appeal state, undo/resume logic, and a single lifecycle-of-record so sellers never receive conflicting dates, channels, or instructions.
Scale the enforcement platform beyond compliance — partnering with policy, science, and marketplace teams to extend the model to any future use case that touches inventory, offers, orders, removals, or seller communication, while distinguishing reversible (Compliance-Pending) from irreversible (Disposition-Required) violations.
Lead cross-functional alignment across CPP/Policy Manager, DISCO, Paragon/AHD, Issue Store, AFT/TASC, FBA, and Retail on the action API contract, policy-authoring validation, and evaluation/enforcement grain alignment — transforming fragmented, downstream-owned enforcement into an automated, policy-driven system with zero unauthorized removals.

Description

AWS Private Pricing is one of the most strategically important commercial programs at Amazon Web Services — enabling enterprise customers to accelerate their cloud transformation through multi-year commitments in exchange for pricing value, expanded service access, and innovation opportunities. The program drives billions in committed revenue and shapes AWS's deepest, longest-lasting customer relationships. Private Pricing is now at an inflection point: we are expanding access beyond traditional enterprise segments, evolving the value proposition, and fundamentally reimagining the deal experience through automation and generative AI.

The Global Deal Strategy and Programs (GDSP) organization owns this program end-to-end. Within GDSP, the Private Pricing Product Management (3PM) team is responsible for the tools, platforms, and technology that power the Private Pricing experience for thousands of internal sellers and external customers globally.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and drive the product strategy for a critical domain within the Private Pricing platform. You will define the vision, build the roadmap, and deliver products that transform how AWS's largest deals are created, structured, and executed. The Opportunity

The GTM AI & Agentic Products team is leading the shift to an Agentic operating model for Adobe GTM and Sales. This function is the orchestration layer that operationalizes Adobe GTM and Sales strategy into end to end Agentic AI workflows that compress planning cycles from months to weeks, launch more personalized campaigns across every route to market, and streamline manual tasks so sellers can focus on talking to customers. We are building an always-on Agentic operating layer that connects strategy, data, and frontline execution for the Digital Media business.

The AI industry is changing quickly, so success in this role requires first principles thinking, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to adapt as the landscape evolves. This opportunity is ideal for a Senior Product Manager who brings a founder approach, enjoys building zero to one products, and has the grit to see them through to impact.

Role Overview

Agentic Planning

Define the product vision and strategy for Planning Agents that support annual and in year planning across multiple products, segments, and regions.
Build Agentic workflows that propose territories, coverage models, capacity plans, quotas, and targeted subgroup plays from live data and clear business constraints.
Embed these Planning Agents into existing planning cadences so leaders can review, adjust, and approve plans instead of starting from scratch.

Campaign Orchestration and Execution

Own the roadmap for Execution Agents that help GTM teams select audiences, prioritize accounts, choose plays, and orchestrate campaigns across key channels and tools.
Partner with marketing, sales development, and Sales teams to codify successful campaigns into reusable Agentic workflows that can be adapted by different segments and regions.
Build a standard experimentation framework so campaigns can be launched in days, tested with clear hypotheses and metrics, and scaled when they work.

Seller Productivity and AI Assistants

Define and deliver seller facing AI assistants that support account research, meeting preparation, opportunity insights, next best actions, and follow-up content.
Map complete seller workflows and identify where Agents can remove friction, from territory and account review to renewal and expansion motions.
Partner with Sales Systems to embed assistants into CRM, email, calendar, and other daily tools, so they fit naturally into seller workflows.

8+ years of product management (2+ years of Agentic AI) experience, with meaningful work in one or more of the following: sales planning, GTM systems, marketing technology, sales tools, or AI powered products.

Comfort working with data and experimentation, including defining success metrics, reviewing analyses, and using insights to drive roadmap decisions.
